item.title: Spaghettifying DRAM
item.description:
📝 Poke the DRAM controller and an address can be made to land wherever you want in memory. skitter-creek-bath-salts reaches into the deepest level of the memory hierarchy and rewires the physical DRAM address translations, to scramble platform memory and release its most guarded secrets — the specialized carveouts invisible even to the kernel. TL;DR Unlock your Platform Security Processor Unlock System Management Mode Unlock C6 DRAM Unlock your CPU microcode Target Developed and tested on AMD Family 16h CPUs, the last generation whose datasheets document the DRAM controller's translation registers — and show that they can't be locked.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/xoreaxeaxeax/skitter-creek-bath-salts
